title: The Scorched Village
text: A village burned so hot that the stones ran like wax and the well boiled dry. Shadows of people are burned onto the walls. In the middle of it all, one house stands untouched, its door open, its curtains stirring.

options.label: Go into the one house still standing, to learn why it was spared.

outcomes.text: It holds a dragon's gift to a favorite. The dragon forgot to come back.
It belongs to a dragon's favorite, who is home.

options.label: The sharpest reads the burn marks to learn what did this.

outcomes.text: It came from the north. It is old, and it took its time.

options.label: Bury what can be buried; someone should.

outcomes.text: It is long work. The shadows on the walls do not fade, but the dead rest.
